caption: The drawing is composed in brown ink on a beige or off-white background and features two main sections within a rectangular border. The upper section contains handwritten Spanish text in a stylized script, occupying about one-third of the rectangle, with small decorative flower motifs arranged above and below the text. The lower section is filled with geometric and floral ornamentation: it is divided by thick diagonal and circular lines into four triangular segments, each decorated with detailed floral, leafy, and symmetrical patterns. Inside the circle at the center, there are four stylized flower motifs, each facing outward into one quadrant. The border of the entire rectangle is also decorated with a repeating pattern of small flower and plant motifs, set between a checkerboard-like edging. The overall color palette consists only of the brown ink used for all lines and details, with the negative space showing the background color.
title: Plate 1: Jemez Book of Marriages: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
